original_reference_rights: No exact-CAS source record was found for these rows, so no underlying publication, numerical datum or publication license is selected.
archive_match_rule: Every row was searched by its exact COMP.csv CAS in the Sander v5.0.0 source archive; analog, name-only, formula-only, ion-to-neutral and alternate-CAS transfers are prohibited.
admission_rule: Every row remains unavailable to Henry correlation and reference-point dispatch until exact identity and suitable primary or redistributable water-solvent evidence are qualified.
uncertainty_and_range_rule: No uncertainty interval, pressure basis or finite validity range exists because no numerical source record is admitted.

identified_hydrocarbon_no_archive_record.definition_assessment: A database molecular identity exists, but the reviewed source archive contains no exact-CAS record and therefore supplies no intrinsic infinite-dilution water coefficient, units, pressure basis, uncertainty or range.
identified_hydrocarbon_no_archive_record.required_evidence: An exact-identity primary publication or redistributable measured water dataset with Henry convention, units, conditions, uncertainty and finite validity range; a single value must use reference-temperature-only semantics.

water_phase_or_mixture_not_solute.definition_assessment: Ice and seawater are condensed water phase or solvent-mixture roles, not neutral molecular solutes in water.
water_phase_or_mixture_not_solute.required_evidence: Use phase-equilibrium, water-property or electrolyte solvent models appropriate to the component role; do not create a water-solute Henry coefficient.

placeholder_or_undefined_pseudocomponent.definition_assessment: Placeholder CAS/formula fields or an operational pseudocomponent do not establish a unique molecular identity for Henry-data transfer.
placeholder_or_undefined_pseudocomponent.required_evidence: Correct or explicitly define the molecular identity first, then qualify exact-identity water data; pseudocomponents require a documented characterization model rather than an analog Henry constant.

reactive_amine_or_model_species.definition_assessment: Reactive amine absorption or a reaction-model aggregate cannot be represented by an unmatched neutral-solute constant without species and reaction standard-state qualification.
reactive_amine_or_model_species.required_evidence: Exact species identity plus joint Henry/reaction-standard-state evidence with composition, pH, units, uncertainty, range and unchanged reactive-VLE benchmarks.

salt_or_reactive_inorganic_not_neutral_m.definition_assessment: A salt formula unit or dissociating reactive inorganic is not an independently volatile neutral molecular solute merely because its stored net charge is zero.
salt_or_reactive_inorganic_not_neutral_m.required_evidence: Species-resolved electrolyte activity, dissociation, solubility or solid-equilibrium evidence; admit a neutral Henry constant only if an independently volatile neutral species is explicitly defined and validated.

sulfur_allotrope_condensed_species.definition_assessment: Condensed S8 identity and dissolved sulfur speciation are distinct from an intrinsic gas-water neutral-solute Henry convention.
sulfur_allotrope_condensed_species.required_evidence: Allotrope- and species-resolved phase/solubility evidence with explicit standard state, units, conditions, uncertainty and range; no transfer from generic elemental sulfur.
